proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Map persistent data, media, service data, AI inference, subprocessors and support access for the exact configuration.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Architecture diagram, DPA/subprocessor list, region matrix, security response
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any mandatory path violates policy or is undocumented.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show a comparable strict-sovereignty deployment and exact processing path.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: European sovereign positioning is assumed to cover every data/AI path.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every mandatory locality/control requirement is satisfied and evidenced.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run buyer-shaped peak, failover and dependency load tests.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Load results, limit matrix, escalation path
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Headroom, failover or dependency limit fails.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show the largest comparable topology and failure test.
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Traffic model, queues, APIs, regions, carrier failover
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Published 60k simultaneous-call / 12M-day scale is assumed to guarantee this buyer's peak topology.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Required peak + failover with agreed headroom and no SLA/queue/API violation.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Fail carrier/region/SBC/number-routing dependencies under buyer traffic.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Call traces, MOS, failover timing, routing evidence
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Material call loss or unsupported country/failover design.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How was a carrier or region outage handled in production?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Operator heritage is assumed to remove carrier/voice failure risk.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Calls reroute within agreed RTO with acceptable quality and no silent loss.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Operate two isolated clients with shared/dedicated agents, WEM, reporting, recordings, knowledge and cost attribution.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cross-client leakage, switching failure or unattributable usage.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How do you isolate clients and charge back shared services?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: BlueLink proof is assumed to establish all multi-client BPO controls.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No unauthorized cross-client visibility; required shared-agent model works; usage is attributable.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Inject tool failure, duplicate request, permission mismatch and downstream timeout into an AI Agent transaction.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Tool logs, trace, audit, escalation, compensation evidence
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Silent failure, duplicate/unauthorized action or no recovery path.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show a failed production-like AI transaction and recovery.
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Sandbox tools, test identities, reversible transaction
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Agentic AI is assumed safe for transactional actions.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No unauthorized/duplicate action; failure detected; audit + safe escalation/compensation.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Document model/provider by workflow and change one model/provider in test.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unknown provider/location/data use or unacceptable lock-in.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How are model/provider changes communicated and validated?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: AI engine/provider/location is assumed portable and sovereignty-safe.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Buyer can identify provider, location, data use, version and fallback for every material AI workflow.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Demonstrate proposed native/partner WEM end-to-end: data, scheduling/QM, admin, incident and upgrade.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Architecture, admin screens, support RACI, data flow
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unclear ownership, data gaps or duplicate admin create operational risk.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which WEM product is actually used in comparable customers?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: WFM/QM is assumed to be one native architecture.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All critical workflows operate with one documented support RACI and acceptable latency/data consistency.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run inbound/outbound/digital, transfer, failure and write-back scenarios in the chosen CRM.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: CRM logs, CTI events, write-back and recovery
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How are CRM connector incidents jointly triaged?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Packaged CRM integration is assumed to support buyer-specific workflows.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Required context, control and write-back survive faults and transfers.

proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Material unknown redesign or data loss remains.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What percentage of comparable legacy assets required redesign?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Large migration proof is assumed to translate to this incumbent estate.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Migration/redesign effort is measurable and acceptance criteria pass.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Compare AI scoring to calibrated human benchmark across representative interactions.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Bias/error beyond threshold or no audit/appeal.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How often do customers recalibrate automated evaluation?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: AI QM/automated evaluation is assumed accurate.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Agreement/error thresholds meet buyer policy; disputes are reviewable.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Export recordings, transcripts, configs, reports, AI/QM data and audit history from a test tenant.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Export files, schema, timing, service quote
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Critical artifacts cannot be exported or require unplanned services.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Describe a completed customer exit and what was portable.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: API/report access is assumed to equal full exitability.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All required artifacts export in documented usable formats inside exit window.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Model three-year base/peak/growth with license, telecom, WEM, AI, storage, services, labor and exit.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Quote, SKU matrix, assumptions, sensitivity model
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show three-year run-state economics for comparable scope.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Sovereign/full-service architecture is assumed economically competitive.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: TCO remains inside buyer threshold under growth and AI scenarios.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Execute required dial modes, pacing, consent/DNC, time zone and reporting scenarios.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What outbound compliance controls are native by country?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Outbound breadth is assumed sufficient for regulated campaigns.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All mandatory controls operate and audit trail is complete.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run a representative release/regression exercise across CRM, WEM, AI and custom flows.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Breaking change or unsupported rollback exceeds tolerance.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How much notice is given for breaking/deprecated integration changes?
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Twice-yearly releases and partner changes are assumed low-risk.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Critical workflows pass and rollback/escalation fit buyer change window.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Fail core platform dependency plus CRM/AI/WEM/carrier dependency separately.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Failover timing, dependency map, incident evidence
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: End-to-end service fails despite platform availability.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show a recent end-to-end continuity exercise.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: 99.95% SLA is assumed to equal end-to-end business continuity.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Business continuity and recovery meet buyer RTO/RPO/service thresholds.
